---
name: Request a new dataset
about: Ask us to add a manifest for a dataset that isn't yet supported
title: "[dataset] add <dataset-name>"
labels: dataset-request, good-first-issue
---

**Dataset name**
Official name + canonical home page URL.

**Task(s)**
Classification / segmentation / detection / other.

**Why it matters**
A sentence on what people use this for (medical imaging, autonomous driving, etc.).

**License**
What license is the dataset under? Is it freely redistributable, or
registration-gated, or paid?

**Where to download from**
Direct URLs, Kaggle slug, HuggingFace repo id, or a description of the
manual download process.

**Approximate size**
e.g. "~5 GB images + 200 MB annotations"

**Format**
On-disk format (folder structure, COCO JSON, CSV labels, mask PNGs, ...)

---

**🤝 Want to add it yourself?** Adding a manifest is the easiest first
contribution — usually a single YAML file. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
